title: Page 317
transc:
Ft Monroe  830 P. M.
Sheldon No 1  Washington D. C. Mar. 29 65
Nelly for pilgrim James Vinton unity princess Allen 
will send to you a number of small
prop - hellers handsome barges which I wish Utah
send thro the can - alto More head City
---- Thayer intended to tablet supplies for Kennebec's
opal & its important that they reach their
destination with as little delays possible ---- You
must take such small tugs as you can
raise inure vicinity to talbot the barges ----
There arnon here ---- I have asked foray
number of additional tugs & will send them
to you as fasts they arrive Ans sig
Rucker Another for same Zebra The double deck
barge St Nicholas was sent to blubber wedge
with mules & the Oregon to animal with
cattle ---- peru thieve landed their cargo please
send both of these barges thro the can
Alto More head City with as little delays
posble ---- If tarquin send a tug to
black optic proper time & get the St
Nicholas after her cargo has been landed Ans.
DH Rucker
2m
